title: US monthly equity expiration (October 2027) — the last session before the FOMC communications blackout opens
source: EST: OCC'S OWN 2027 EXPIRATION CALENDAR, fetched and decoded in-session 2026-09-06 on the same artifact this repo's opex-2027-09-17 entry cites. The Options Industry Council's backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) -- a publication of The Options Clearing Corporation, whose every page footer reads "(c)2026 The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved." -- carries the row {"date":"2027-10-15T00:00:00","events":[{"type":"6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B"}]}, and that GUID maps in the same document's own legend to "Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading". The adjacent rows corroborate the reading: 2027-10-14 carries GUID 15AA2B9D ("Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading"), the standing one-day-earlier convention, and 2027-10-20 carries EEF1643B ("Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date"), proposed separately as vix-expiration-2027-10-20. INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED BY THE STANDING RULE: monthly equity options expire on the third Friday, and October 2027's third Friday is 2027-10-15 (October 1 2027 is a Friday, so the Fridays are the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th). Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not flip a status without an IR:/BLS:/FED: primary, and because a published expiration calendar four-teen months out remains subject to the publisher's own amendment; the promotion trigger is theocc.com serving its own 2027 calendar to a session that can reach it. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). THE HOLE: this calendar tracks monthly opex continuously from 2026-08-21 through 2027-06-17 and then again at 2027-09-17, but nothing for July, August, October, November or December 2027 -- October's is proposed here because it is the operative date in the parent's corridor, not because the series should be backfilled by this lane. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PARENT, AND THE ONE THING NOT TO CONCLUDE FROM IT: 2027-10-15 is the LAST SESSION on which any FOMC participant may speak before the communications blackout opens at 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-10-16, so the Fed's cut-off and October's monthly expiration are the same 16:00 ET close. That coincidence is STRUCTURAL AND MEASURED INERT, not an edge: the parent ledger found the October blackout's deadline session is monthly opex in 9 of the 10 realized October gates 2007-2025 (all but 2012), because a fourth- or fifth-Tuesday meeting always puts the second-Saturday-before on the day after the third Friday. And across all 168 FOMC gates in that span, the 57 whose deadline session is opex run 0.844% mean absolute S&P move against 0.745% for the other 111 while VIX FALLS 0.361 points against a 0.062 rise -- a post-expiration volatility drop, which is an opex property rather than a blackout property. Impact medium matches the other monthly (non-quarterly) opex entries in this calendar; October 2027 is a monthly, not a triple-witching quarterly. Same channel caveat as every calendar entry here: symbols is empty and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
